fragile.name: Fragile
fragile.text: Breaks at a hit with a force of {limit} or more.

volatile.name: Volatile
volatile.text: Explodes at a hit with a force of {limit} or more. The explosion breaks the cargo around it.

fluid.name: Fluid
fluid.text: Leaks at a hit with a force of {limit} or more. The leak shorts each Electronic cargo next to it.

electronic.name: Electronic
electronic.text: Shorts when a Fluid cargo next to it leaks.

perishable.name: Perishable
perishable.text: Spoils at the arrival if it is not next to a Cooler.

thruster.name: Thruster
thruster.text: Slides 1 cell at most in each shift step.

cushion.name: Cushion
cushion.text: Each hit on it or by it has a force of 0.

cooler.name: Cooler
cooler.text: Keeps each Perishable cargo next to it fresh.

battery.name: Battery
battery.text: Powers each Shield next to it.

shield.name: Shield
shield.text: With power, it protects each cargo next to it from one reaction in each jump.

sensor.name: Sensor
sensor.text: At the station, it shows the direction of the fork step.

zone.name: Zone
zone.text: Each piece arrives in the {size} lines at the {side}.

not_next_to.name: Keep Apart
not_next_to.text: No piece arrives next to {trait} cargo.
